newsitem.title: USA: Travelers PC launches workers' comp plan.
newsitem.headline: Travelers PC launches workers' comp plan.

text.p: Travelers Property Casualty Corp, the biggest provider of workers' compensation insurance services in the U.S, said on Wednesday it is launching a workers' compensation program designed to help companies lower costs while improving workers' health and productivity.
It said in a statement that the TravComp 2000 program would be available nationwide in July.
The company said the new program was suitable for all of its business customers, but that it would be most beneficial to large companies.

TravComp 2000 uses a sophisticated database to provide customers with detailed, easily understood claim cost reports and site-specific cost management recommendations unlike any other program available in the industry, Travelers said.

It said TravComp 2000 features a comprehensive, coordinated claim and medical management process which teams workers' compensation claim and medical management professionals in 50 local offices and supports them with managed care information software.
"Combined with our managed care network and our systems superiority, TravComp 2000 gives us a competitive edge," said Stanton Long, vice chairman of Travelers Property Casualty.
The company said a year-long TravComp 2000 pilot program produced savings that averaged about 10 percent on claims that closed within the year.
Travelers Property Casualty is an 82-percent owned subsidiary of Travelers Group. It was formed in April 1996 through the merger of Travelers' and Aetna Inc 's property-casualty business.
